car.name: Silverleaf 200 2018
car.description: A compact premium turbocharged five-door survivor, inspired by the 2018 A 200. Original unbadged 2994 design. Seven-speed dual-clutch, front-wheel drive.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: 2018 EU W177 A 200 five-door hatchback, M282 petrol, FWD, 7G-DCT, non-hybrid; LHD with optional 205/55R17 wheels

estimates: 120 kW converted to mechanical hp, not rounded 163 PS as SAE hp. 250 Nm converted to lb-ft. Published 1375kg mass retained with no driver adjustment. UK brochure supplies shared W177 drivetrain/dimensions; artwork and cockpit are LHD, not a claim of UK LHD availability.

Physical gear ratios, final drive, reverse ratio, 6500 cutoff/6000 redline, idle, shift timing, boost pressure, open differential, CG, axle load, suspension, steering, clearance and Cd .25 are simulation estimates. No authoritative exact GETRAG ratios were located; these are NOT claimed as OEM ratios.

0–60 estimate 7.8s is separate from manufacturer 0–62mph 8.0s. Torque outside the published plateau and power anchor is interpolated simulation tuning. Fuel 38 US mpg is a gameplay estimate. Wheel radius .32865m is unloaded nominal 205/55R17 geometry. Tracks and body sub-shapes are simulation estimates.
Original logo-free 2994 art. Shared WRX-size steering wheel with live wheel-opening gauges. Surface-specific tire smoke/spray inherited; no exaggerated diesel smoke.
